sector.narrative: Support for feminist, women-led and women's rights organisations and movements, and institutions (governmental and non-govermental) at all levels to enhance their effectiveness, influence and substainability (activities and core-funding). These organisations exist to bring about transformative change for gender equality and/or the rights of women and girls in developing countries. Their activities include agenda-setting, advocacy, policy dialogue, capacity development, awareness raising and prevention, service provision, conflict-prevention and peacebuilding, research, organising, and alliance and network building

• 1 networking meeting with district-level organizations was conducted on 12th March 2023 at UST, Adabor, Dhaka. The meeting saw the participation of representatives from local networking organizations in the four project implementing areas (Kaukhali, Dhobaura, Jamalpur, and Tahirpur), along with 100 Young Women Leaders (YWLs) and the project team, bringing the total number of participants to 120. During the meeting, project updates were shared with the networking organizations, and their representatives had the opportunity to share their learnings and experiences.The meeting proved instrumental in fostering network and alliances among the organizations operating in the project areas. The YWLs also actively participated and expressed their experiences and emotions about working in collaboration with these organizations. Such networking sessions play a crucial role in strengthening partnerships and promoting effective coordination to achieve common goals in the project's implementation areas. • One networking meeting was conducted on 11 September at the head office of the 'Social Association of Rural Advancement' (SARA) in Mymensingh. The meeting saw the active participation of Young Women Leaders (YWLs), group members, staff from networking organizations' head offices and branch offices, executive members, and the project team. A total of 32 individuals attended the meeting. During this collaborative session, various aspects of the project were deliberated upon, including its goals, objectives, and activities to date, future planning, strategic collaboration between organizations, and the current scenario of the locality. The meeting proved to be a fruitful platform for sharing insights among participants, fostering a sense of shared journey and facilitating discussions on future endeavors. Target was conducting 5 networking meetings in project implementing areas. To build and strengthen collaboration and create shared value among the networking organizations 1 networking meeting held at Dhaka with participation of 4 networking organizations, YWLs from 5 areas with Naripokkho project team. And 1 networking meeting held with the networking organization SARA to design activity and share knowledge and experiences working in indigenous community. The meetings organized and conducted focusing on qualitative impact rather than just completing activities based on quantitative numbers.

comment.narrative: As the indicator measures any new values occurring since the start of the intervention, the baseline value is set at 0
Through capacity development and inclusion programs

4 WROs; Taranga Mohila kllyan Sangstha from Jamalpur, DDS Foundation from Pirojpur, Efforts for Rural Advancement (ERA) from Sunamganj and Social Association of rural Advancement (SARA) from Mymensingh with more capacities to influence Women's Rights Organization led spaces and address SGBV faced by WGWDs as part of broader goal for women’s empowerment during the year 2022. The WROs have participated in WGG activities; area mappings, project inception meetings, networking meetings, duty bearers meetings, stakeholders meetings; along with Naripokkho’s activities; day observations, meetings, webinars; in person and also online throughout the year. Naripokkho also shared different documents; posters, brochures, leaflets etc. with these 4 WROs. Thus they were able to enrich their knowledge regarding recent issues.
Through capacity development and inclusion programs

4 networking meeting was conducted on 24 March, 1 April, 4 June and 30 June, at the head office of the `Efforts for Rural Advancement’ (ERA) in Sunamganj, 'Social Association of Rural Advancement' (SARA) in Mymensingh, `Doctor Dhiren Shikder’ (DDS) Foundation office, Kaukhali and Kalshi. Staffs, executive members, from networking organization and the project team have participated in the meeting. Total 88 participants (28in Sunamganj, 22 in Mymensingh, 22 in Kaukhali and 16 in kalshi) have attended the meetings. During the meeting the participants discussed about activities of the project, future planning, collaboration between organizations etc. The meetings enhance the commitment between organizations and stakeholders for a journey towards a shared goal. Naripokkho shared the messages written on wall in the year 2023 and 2024. Based on the messages networking organization ERA has also implemented the same initiative in their working area. And later shared with Naripokkho team that the initiative was a success and they got appreciated for the initiative. Based on learning, sharing discussion with Naripokkho team networking organization SARA have designed their activities jointly with Bengali and indigenous community to strengthen communal harmony. Naripokkho shared day observation (International Women’s Day, International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women) declaration, leaflet and brochure related SGBV and SRHR with the 4 networking organizations.
